jurisdiction.name: Honduras
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Honduras has no national AI law, AI strategy or official AI guidance, and no general data protection law. The only traces are a data protection bill pending since 2015, a banking regulator (CNBS) questionnaire on financial institutions' use of AI, and government announcements of AI pilot projects with the Inter-American Development Bank.
lead_institutions: Instituto de Acceso a la Información Pública (IAIP)
Comisión Nacional de Bancos y Seguros (CNBS)
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026, but the National Congress's, the information access institute's and the digital government agency's websites could not be accessed, and the official gazette has no full-text search, so no official AI document could be recorded. Honduras is marked for a later retry. The data protection bill and the banking regulator's AI questionnaire are tracked as leads.

leads.title: Anteproyecto de Ley de Protección de Datos Personales
leads.issuing_authority: Instituto de Acceso a la Información Pública (IAIP) / Congreso Nacional
leads.note: Pending. Honduras has no general data protection law; the IAIP first submitted a draft to the Congreso Nacional in 2015 and presented an updated draft to deputies in 2024. Secondary sources report it still awaiting a committee opinion (dictamen) in August 2026. No official text found online (iaip.gob.hn unreachable; congresonacional.hn returned errors). Record the law once published in La Gaceta.

leads.title: Uso de Herramientas Tecnológicas que Incorporan Inteligencia Artificial (CNBS)
leads.english_title: Use of Technological Tools Incorporating Artificial Intelligence (CNBS questionnaire)
leads.issuing_authority: Comisión Nacional de Bancos y Seguros (CNBS)
leads.note: Page on the CNBS website (https://www.cnbs.gob.hn/uso-de-herramientas-tecnologicas-que-incorporan-inteligencia-artificial/) that embeds only a Microsoft Forms questionnaire, apparently surveying AI use; the form content could not be loaded and no rule, guidance text or stated publication date is on the page. Information-gathering, not an AI instrument; re-check for any resulting CNBS AI guidance or norm. CNBS's IT/cybersecurity and technology-risk norms do not address AI.

leads.title: Mesa técnica Gobierno–BID para la simplificación administrativa con inteligencia artificial
leads.english_title: Government–IDB technical working group on AI-based administrative simplification
leads.issuing_authority: Secretaría de Estado de la Presidencia
leads.note: Announced on sep.gob.hn ('Honduras modernizará el Estado con apoyo de la Inteligencia Artificial', 2026): a technical table with the IDB to pilot an AI platform that reviews laws, regulations and procedures for red tape. Government use-of-AI project announcement; no governing document found. Promote only if a decree/PCM or policy document is issued.
